change: Separate constitutive model; no energy offset inside switch; preserves raw forces below switch onset, not exact legacy total energy
relaxation: Original source initial structures; z-only CG; same legacy settings, no load or bath
retained_stability: Positive minimum eigenvalue after uniform translation removed, not interval proof
energy_controls: At every case and cutoff: first/last Helmert and breathing; curvature, first derivative and x/y mixed derivatives; h=.002,.001,.0005 A; both .001 and .0005 must pass
cutoff_endpoint_gate: 20 versus24 A relative Frobenius K<=1e-4, g<=1e-3; all local and energy gates also required
baseline_comparison: Report same-cutoff K/g relative differences and equilibrium geometry against unchanged legacy arrays; no selection by closeness
pair_implementation_gate: Independent analytic switched energies and forces at contact, onset, interior and both cutoff sides, <=1e-12 absolute metal units; finite energy derivatives <=1e-8 absolute
scope: Numerical robustness to declared widths1,2,3 A at finite cutoffs16,20,24 A; no arbitrary-width/infinite-range/physical conclusion
width2_policy: Reuse previous model matrices, raw energy controls and logs by SHA256, no rerun and no overwrites
width_sensitivity_gate: For every case and cutoff, all3 unordered width pairs must satisfy relative Frobenius differences K<=1e-4, g<=1e-3; denominator is larger width matrix norm. All local/energy/endpoint gates must also pass.
response_diagnostic: Report constrained K inverse g norm changes across widths; no extra acceptance threshold
